items.title: #207 - Nathan Lund and Sam Tallent
items.description: Nathan Lund and Sam Tallent return to the pod to discuss Sam's new novel BRUT, Nathan's potential big plans for 2027, the lie that work will set you free, the economics of saying farewell to your canine companion, shaving your head stupidly to make your pal laugh, weight loss, NFL salaries, and much more. Nathan, Sam and Stav help callers including a man who's mom drained his savings account to pay for a TikTok crypto scam, and a liberal woman from Austin who's wondering if she can pop off on her conservative family for Thanksgiving. items.title: Dr. Sarah Paine: Why The World Is Turning Away From America
items.description: Are escalating geopolitical tensions hurtling humanity towards World War III? Dr. Sarah Paine highlights the historical roots of geopolitical conflicts and demonstrates how shifting away from a rules-based maritime order guarantees economic collapse. Dr. Sarah Paine is a renowned geopolitical strategist, historian, and retired professor from the U.S. Naval War College, specializing in Russian and Chinese imperial history and maritime strategy. items.title: #499 — The Birth of AGI
items.description: Sam Harris speaks with Kevin Roose about the race to build artificial general intelligence. They discuss Roose's book The AGI Chronicles, the scaling laws behind AI's rapid progress, Dario Amodei's "big blob of compute" memo, the birth of reasoning models, Roose's encounter with Bing's Sydney chatbot, the roughly 50 people deciding humanity's future, the rivalries among lab leaders, AI agents and recursive self-improvement, the absence of regulation, and other topics.
